description: Determine whether NIS2 (and its national transposition) applies to an organization, and whether it is an essential or important entity. Inputs: EU/EEA country (ISO-2), primary NIS2 sector, headcount, turnover/balance sheet in M EUR, size-independent types (DNS, TLD, trust services, public electronic communications; cloud, data-centre and CDN providers follow the size test). Returns classification, reasoning, the national transposition law with its deviations, and next-step links.

annual_turnover_meur.description: Annual turnover in millions of EUR

cloud_provider.description: Cloud computing provider: Annex I digital infrastructure, size-tested like any other entity (not size-independent)

country.description: ISO-2 country code of the organization (e.g. IT, PL, FR)

public_ecn_provider.description: Provider of public electronic communications networks or services: in scope regardless of size, essential from medium size (Art. 3(1)(c))

sector.description: Primary NIS2 sector id (see the sector list in the tool description)

sole_provider.description: Sole provider of a service essential to society in its Member State

trust_service_provider.description: Trust service provider (eIDAS), qualified or not: in scope regardless of size; non-qualified ones are important unless large

name: scope_check
title: NIS2 scope check
